name: Refractive Radiative Transfer Equation
aliases: RTE with spatially varying index of refraction
definition: A generalization of the radiative transfer equation to heterogeneous participating media with a spatially varying index of refraction (represented as a continuous scalar field), accounting for curved trajectories and correct conservation of energy via an extended definition of radiance.
summary: The Refractive Radiative Transfer Equation models light transport in media with spatially varying refractive indices, accounting for curved ray trajectories and energy conservation unlike standard models.
